title: Update package manifests and desktop certification harness
summary: Extended packaging/tests/test_desktop_cert.sh with 8 new certification sections (m-t) covering GNOME redesigned source resources, Manager3 introspection availability, translation seam, executable linkage, build-output-absence hygiene, core GTK-free invariant, exact-version dependency, and a mutation test. No install-manifest.toml, PKGBUILD, Debian, or Fedora manifest changes were needed — tasks 9-13 added only Rust source files compiled into the existing namtor-enroll-wizard binary, and the v3 D-Bus introspection XML is already compiled into the daemon binary via include_str!.

manifest_changes.install-manifest.toml: no change — GNOME entries (binary, .desktop, .metainfo.xml, .svg) already correct
manifest_changes.arch/PKGBUILD: no change — already builds namtor-gnome crate which compiles all new source files
manifest_changes.debian/control: no change — namtor-gnome Depends already correct (namtor exact + libgtk-4-1 + libadwaita-1-0)
manifest_changes.debian/namtor-gnome.install: no change — already lists binary + desktop + metainfo + icon
manifest_changes.fedora/namtor.spec: no change — %files gnome already lists binary + desktop + metainfo + icon
manifest_changes.dbus-contract-v3.xml: not installed separately — compiled into daemon binary via include_str! (consistent with v1/v2)

test_sections_added.m: GNOME redesigned source resources present (DESIGN.md, shell.rs, navigation.rs, a11y.rs, system_status.rs, components, shell_navigation tests)
test_sections_added.n: Manager3 introspection XML available (v3 source exists, compiled into daemon, declares Manager3, preserves v1+v2)
test_sections_added.o: Translation seam (tr() in lib.rs, POTFILES.in, .pot template, no compiled .mo files)
test_sections_added.p: Executable linkage (Cargo.toml binary declaration, wizard.rs source, manifest mapping, desktop Exec=, metainfo provides/binary)
test_sections_added.q: No generated build output (.omo gitignored, arch/src gitignored, arch/pkg gitignored, no screenshots, no biometric data outside ml/fixtures, no package archives)
test_sections_added.r: Core package GTK-free (Arch/Fedora/Debian core has no gtk4/libadwaita deps)
test_sections_added.s: namtor-gnome depends on namtor exact version (Arch namtor=$pkgver, Fedora namtor=ver-rel, Debian namtor=0.1.0-1)
test_sections_added.t: Mutation test (stage gnome, remove metainfo XML, cert fails; restore, cert passes — round-trip)

daemon_tests.result: 451 passed, 3 failed (pre-existing manager::worker::tests failures, daemon-side enrollment worker code outside packaging scope), 1 ignored
daemon_tests.note: The 3 failures are in manager::worker::tests (worker_cancel, worker_resume, worker_stop) — pre-existing enrollment worker test issues from tasks 9-13, not caused by packaging changes. Task 14 scope is packaging only; daemon-side code must not be modified.
